items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: So there was Lucky, Taft Smith, Deak Deke Watson and Bill Kinney -- these were the four guys I had to deal to.

ctx.x: Anyway, I beat Taft, and I beat Deak, no, I beat Taft and I beat Lucky, and I pushed with Deak and I pushed Bill Kinney. So now I got a second time to deal around. Lucky took $25, Taft took $25, Deak took
Kinney said, $25, Bill said to Deal the rest here." Dealed the cards around; opened up my hand, I got 17 to hit.
